text:
nora: Heads up: Private/VPC release 2.8 will introduce a "local-forwarder" option and an explicit Data Residency Opt-Out policy. Deploy target: 2026-06-15 23:00 UTC. This primarily helps customers who require telemetry to never transit Redwood infrastructure unless they opt in.

lee_ops: Can you clarify "local-forwarder"? Is that the same as the proxy mode from earlier releases?

talia_product: Not identical. Local-forwarder ships as a lightweight sidecar that buffers telemetry to a customer-controlled endpoint or local archive. Key difference: the forwarder can run fully air-gapped and write to a mounted archive (S3-compatible or NFS) with signed integrity checks.

michael_sales: We need simple customer language for partners. Also which installs get this by default?

talia_product: New Private installers starting on the GA timestamp will DEFAULT to telemetry=OFF and local-forwarder disabled. Customers can enable local-forwarder during install or later via console/CLI. Existing installs are untouched for 180 days and will receive the migration FAQ.

legal_review: Legal required items: 1) explicit list of telemetry categories that can be forwarded (health metrics, agent heartbeats, encrypted agent logs), 2) statement that request payloads are never forwarded without explicit consent, 3) minimum retention choices (30/90/365). Draft notice will be posted in #legal-review.

lee_ops: Operational notes: support bundles will still be available, but by default we'll only receive hashed identifiers. For emergency debug we will require a temporary consent token generated by the customer's console or CLI. Runbook will describe the token flow and audit tails.

ci-bot: CI pipeline scheduled: onprem-2.8-local-forwarder-release build: https://ci.internal/build/81022. Smoke tests: staging/forwarder-smoke tonight 02:00 PT.

talia_product: CLI examples:
`# enable local forwarder and point to customer endpoint`
`redwoodctl private update --tenant <TENANT_ID> --set forwarder.mode=endpoint --set forwarder.endpoint=https://telemetry.corp.example/collect`

`# enable write-to-archive mode (air-gapped)`
`redwoodctl private update --tenant <TENANT_ID> --set forwarder.mode=archive --set forwarder.archive.path=/mnt/telemetry/`

michael_sales: Draft GTM blurb requested: one sentence security-focused and one sentence partner-facing. Ill add to the product-commms thread and iterate with legal.

nora: Migration plan summary: 1) no silent flips for existing tenants for 180 days, 2) targeted email + in-console modal explaining choices and retaining current settings, 3) one-click opt-in and a CLI path, 4) 30/60/90-day monitoring for errors and opt-in rates, 5) rollback option if customers report export failures.

lee_ops: Add alerts for forwarder backlog >5% and export write errors >1% per tenant in first 72h. Also validate checksum mismatches for archive mode.

legal_review: Approved customer notice with small wording changes. Please include link to consent audit trail in the console modal.

nora: Action items: Talia to publish the public KB and migration FAQ, Lee to add monitors and run staging smoke, Michael to prepare partner-facing lines, Legal to post final wording. Sync tomorrow 09:00 PT.

michael_sales: :thumbsup: will have partner copy by EOD.
